visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of square image teaser cards, each card one link
visualCharacteristics.layout: 12 / 6 / 4 column grid of 1:1 image cards with gradient veil, theme meta line and h5 title
notable: Whole card is a single link taken from the heading link
Cards slide in from the right on scroll, staggered
Adopts a following link-box or newsroom-feed block as the last aside column
dated variant shows a dd.mm.yyyy date badge over the image edge

contentPattern.structure: One cell per card: a picture paragraph, an optional date paragraph (dated), an optional theme/meta paragraph, and a heading whose link is the card target

usage: Use for a grid of linked image teasers such as topic pages or newsroom news items
reuseGuidance: Fits short linked teasers with a square image and title; not for long body text, multiple CTAs per card or unlinked feature lists
